screen.petphrasex.config.title: PetPhraseX Configuration
screen.petphrasex.config.ignore_mark.des: Messages starting with this mark will skip all effects.
screen.petphrasex.config.remove_ignore_m: If enabled, the ignore mark will be removed before the message is sent.
screen.petphrasex.config.prefix.desc: Text added to the very beginning of the whole message.
screen.petphrasex.config.suffix.desc: Text added to the very end of the whole message.
screen.petphrasex.config.sentence_prefix: Text added before every individual word in the message.
screen.petphrasex.config.sentence_suffix: Text added after every individual word in the message.
